emails.subject: Software Engineering Internship – Aditya Mittal
emails.body:
Hi Oxus team,

Weeks of audit walkthrough documentation turned into something that runs in minutes is the kind of problem I like picking apart.

During my internship at Basepair I fixed an OAuth race condition with DB-level row locking and cleared 100+ BLOCKER and HIGH SonarQube issues across a Django and React codebase, so I'm used to making production systems hold up under real use.

I'm a 2027 CS grad looking for an internship or entry-level role. Are you taking on engineers right now?
